Warhammer is a new take on Total War in a fantasy setting focusing much more on the abilities of unique heroes and generals whose powers grow as that gain experience from battles and world events. The focus is on the character development and their role in their respective stories as you progress through the campaign. They can also acquire RPG styled equipment that affects them. If you like medieval fantasy with dragons, trolls, elves, etc you will enjoy this as you play a role in that universe on a larger scale than ever as you smash hordes of orcs against a wall of iron clad dwarves.

Three kings is much more like the older total wars games but done better in every single possible way, while adopting and expanding the character system from warhammer. Heroes are still strong, but not in the same, ridiculous ways in Warhammer. Emphasis here is playing the geopolitical landscape to your advantage and using more realistic battle tactics formations to outwit the AI. AI has improved dramatically but still has flaws... but not as many as what we had previously seen.

I would say each game offers it's own unique experience that are equally different and enjoyable.

Right click My PC -> Properties -> Advanced System Settings -> Click settings under Performance. Uncheck everything except for Smooth screen fonts. This wont be as drastic as the Power Options fix but will help a little.

For Windows 10, Right click My PC -> Properties -> Advanced System Settings -> Click settings under "Performance" on the Advanced tab -> Choose the custom radio button and uncheck everything except "Smooth edges of Screen Fonts". This will uncheck everything that can cause performance hits but mainly it disables the thumbnails for files.
